boot.title: Select the Riot Client folder
boot.hint: It's the folder that contains RiotClientServices.exe. By default it is C:\Riot Games\Riot Client.
home.title: Change account
home.subtitle: Select a profile to play or create a new one
home.stay_signed_in: The first time you sign in with each profile, check "Stay signed in". Otherwise the session can't be saved.
home.empty: You don't have any profiles yet. Create one to get started.
profile.delete_confirm: Delete "%s"? Its saved session will be lost.
form.name: Name
form.name_placeholder: Optional. An automatic name is used if left empty.
form.league_icon_hint: To use your icon, open the League client with this account.
settings.locked: Close the game to change this setting.
error.riot_client_not_configured: The Riot Client folder hasn't been set.
error.riot_client_not_found: RiotClientServices.exe wasn't found in that folder.
error.profile_name_taken: There is already a profile with that name.
error.profile_running: This can't be done while the profile is running.
error.file_locked: A file is in use by another program.
error.session_restore_failed: The profile's session couldn't be restored.
error.processes_still_running: Some Riot processes didn't close in time.
error.launch_failed: The Riot Client couldn't be opened.
error.league_client_not_running: The League client is not open. Open it with this account and try again.
error.league_client_request_failed: Could not get the icon from the League client. Wait for it to finish loading and try again.
error.io: A file couldn't be read or written.
error.busy: Another operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
